title: Grothendieck-Verdier functors
summary: We introduce Grothendieck-Verdier functors between Grothendieck-Verdier, or $\ast$-autonomous, categories. Such functors are lax monoidal functors equipped with a morphism expressing compatibility with Grothendieck-Verdier duality. We show that the resulting $2$-category is $2$-equivalent to that of linearly distributive categories with negation and Frobenius linearly distributive functors. We further extend this $2$-equivalence to the braided setting.
